sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference u/s

The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned court below within one month from today and in case, a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7. For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant,
in the above case.
